title: 第5章 怕暴露身份都杀了第6章 杀再杀烟雨楼内出手者全部杀干净
slug: 八年质子归京岂知天下已刻吾名
lines: “六皇子一个人？”
“千真万确。”
“也对，他在大虞京中毫无根基势力，刚刚回京，急需与镇国王府完婚巩固自身，岂敢光明正大出现在这里露了身份。”
“不过他来又能怎样，无非是偷看罢了，一个废物质子而已。”
宁冀低声一笑，倒也不怕这话被外人听到，因为他身边皆是自己的心腹。
以他的身份，在这烟雨楼中，还真不需要给一个常年不在大夏的废物皇子面子。
更何况，他今日等的便是孟尘前来。
他不是与这沈知薇有旧吗？
今天，他正好当着这六皇子的面，好好玩一玩这烟雨楼的沈仙子！
比才力，他不行。
但比财力吗，在场的众公子中，没几个是他的对手。
这烟雨楼，就是个烧金窟，只要与女人有关的事，有钱便可以为所欲为。
在他看来，任那孟尘再不爽，也奈何自己不得。
甚至，连自己皇子的身份都不敢动用。
“快让沈仙子出现一见！”
“柳妈妈，不要那么麻烦了，这是一万两银票，足够了！”
“今夜我就要她陪我了！”
宁冀话落，身后一人直接掏出一万两银票，强行要人。
“这……怕是坏了规矩……”
“沈仙子来此，只卖艺不卖身啊……”
柳妈妈是这烟雨楼的管事妈妈，闻听此言，顿时故作露出难色。
“既入了烟雨楼，又引得我等前来，焉有不卖之礼？”
“三万两！”
宁冀有些不爽，他有的是钱，并不在乎。
既然放出了话，那他便要得到，否则灰溜溜离去，他脸面往哪里搁？
“三万两，这……真不是钱的事……”
柳妈妈听到这个数字，也欣喜激动。
三万两放在任何地方，都不是一个小数目，常人想都不敢想。
她要说不心动，那绝对是假的。
至于她口中所说的卖艺不卖身，这种话放在烟雨楼，其实形同虚设，不过是为了吸引贵客出更高的价钱罢了。
“既如此，我出五万两！”
站在一旁的秦骁，闻言也开口了。
看这柳妈妈风骚故作难为情的样子，他便知道这不是不要钱的事，而是想要更多！
他早已垂涎沈知薇许久，今日有这种机会，自然难得慷慨。
content_en:
"The Sixth Prince is alone?"
"Absolutely true."
"That's right. He has no established power in the capital of Yu. He has just returned to the capital and is in urgent need of marrying the king's palace to consolidate himself. How dare he appear here openly and reveal his identity."
"But what can he do if he comes? He's just taking a peek. He's just a waste of matter."
Ning Ji smiled softly, but he was not afraid that outsiders would hear his words, because he was surrounded by his confidants.
With his status, in this Yanyu Tower, there is really no need to give face to a good-for-nothing prince who has been absent from Daxia all year round.
What's more, what he was waiting for today was Meng Chen's arrival.
Doesn't he have an old relationship with Shen Zhiwei?
Today, he happened to have a good time playing with Fairy Shen from Yanyu Tower in front of the Sixth Prince!
He can't compete with his talents.
But compared to financial resources, few of the young masters present were his opponents.
This Yanyu Tower is just a gold-burning cave. As long as it has to do with women, you can do whatever you want if you have money.
In his opinion, no matter how unhappy Meng Chen was, there was nothing he could do about it.
Even he didn't dare to use his identity as a prince.
"Let Fairy Shen show up quickly!"
"Mother Liu, don't go to so much trouble, this is a ten thousand tael of silver note, it's enough!"
"I want her to accompany me tonight!"
After Ning Ji finished speaking, a person behind him directly took out a 10,000 tael of silver and asked for it.
"This...I'm afraid it's a violation of the rules..."
"Fairy Shen is here to show off her skills but not her body..."
Mother Liu is the mother in charge of Yanyu Building. After hearing this, she immediately pretended to be embarrassed.
"Since you have entered the Yanyu Tower and attracted us to come, how can you not give me a gift?"
"Thirty thousand taels!"
Ning Ji was a little unhappy. He had plenty of money and didn't care.
Now that he has made a promise, he must get it, otherwise he will leave in despair. Where will he put his face?
"Thirty thousand taels, this...is really not about money..."
Liu's mother was also happy and excited when she heard this number.
Thirty thousand taels is not a small amount anywhere, and ordinary people dare not even think about it.
If she said she wasn't moved, that would be absolutely false.
As for what she said about selling her art but not her body, such words are actually useless in Yanyu Tower. They are just to attract distinguished customers to pay higher prices.
"In that case, I'll pay fifty thousand taels!"
Qin Xiao, who was standing aside, also spoke after hearing this.
Seeing the coquettish and embarrassed look on Mother Liu's face, he knew that this was not a matter of asking for money, but that she wanted more!
He has coveted Shen Zhiwei for a long time, and since he has this opportunity today, he is naturally very generous.
title_en: Chapter 5: Kill everyone for fear of exposing their identity Chapter 6: Kill again and again, kill all those who took action in Yanyu Tower
